packageRules.description: Auto-merge grouped non-major build-input updates (mkdocs plugins in requirements.txt, the python base image, and GitHub Actions) as one PR. The image is tagged from the pinned mkdocs-material version, so merging republishes the current tag (or mints a new one when mkdocs-material itself bumps); adarigod's Renovate then follows it via a reviewed PR. Majors stay manual, and an image only publishes on a successful build.
Major bumps (e.g. mkdocs-material 9.x -> 10.x) get their own PR for review.
